name: Icy.030
bio: Icy (born in 2002) is an Italian music producer originally from Varese and now based in Brescia. His sound blends elements of trap, electronic, and ambient music, creating modern, atmospheric productions with a signature cold and cinematic vibe. Known for deep basslines, airy textures, and evocative melodies, Icy has quickly become one of the most promising young producers in the new Italian scene, collaborating with emerging artists and shaping a unique sonic identity. Constantly evolving, he continues to push the boundaries of his sound, turning each track into an immersive experience
genre: Trap / Elettronic / Urban Pop / Tecno ambient

name: RadioTelevisione Italiana
bio: RAI - Radiotelevisione Italiana is the national public broadcasting company of Italy. Founded in 1924 (as URI) and launching regular TV broadcasts in 1954, it represents the history and culture of Italian media. In the music industry, RAI is globally recognized as the historic organizer and official broadcaster of the Festival di Sanremo (Sanremo Music Festival). Since 1951, this iconic event has been the pinnacle of Italian pop music, launching the careers of countless legendary artists and even inspiring the creation of the Eurovision Song Contest.
